name: Install Link — Classic (direct to Edge Manager)
description: Classic linking path: the On-Prem scanner talks GraphQL directly to the Edge Manager (mutation installationLink / installationCreateAndLink). Edge Manager then calls Multitenant API over gRPC to create the site/install. No discovery-config-api in between — that is the vNext difference (see link-vnext). The full lifecycle (licensing, scanning, asset, install-status) is covered in edge-manager-flow.

annotations.text: GraphQL endpoint (mutation installationLink / installationCreateAndLink). Not in Kafka topology — communicates via gRPC only with backend services.

nodes.text: Classic va directo On-Prem -> Edge Manager (GraphQL). vNext pasa por discovery-config-api. Ver flujo link-vnext.
